title: Invariance under coordinate relabeling
statement: Let $m,n\\in\\mathbb N$, let $e:[m]\\to[n]$ be a bijection, let $f:\\{-1,1\\}^m\\to\\{-1,1\\}$ be a sign-valued Boolean function, and let $\\delta\\in\\mathbb R$ and $k\\in\\mathbb N$. Relabel the coordinates of $f$ using $e$ to obtain the function $g(x)=f(i\\mapsto x(e(i)))$ on $\\{-1,1\\}^n$. Then $P_{\\delta,k}(g)=P_{\\delta,k}(f)$.
hypotheses_covered: A bijection from the $m$ coordinates to the $n$ coordinates
A sign-valued Boolean function on the $m$-coordinate sign cube
